top3.why: Lightbox Film Center — the city's premier venue for exactly this kind of discovery — brings its Philadelphia premiere of monument to Bok. The listing gives no synopsis beyond the premiere billing, so this is one to research before buying a ticket, but Lightbox's track record alone is reason enough to go. South Philly, an easy trip from home.

top3.title: Queer Life Drawing
top3.venue: Tattooed Moms, 530 South Street, Philadelphia, PA 19147
